# design-os-knowledge-builder

> Universal multimodal ingestion (PDF, video, audio, web), 3-tier cost-optimized orchestration, and formal logic epistemic stopping gate for AI agents.

Universal Multimodal Knowledge Pipeline & Epistemic Stopping Gate for AI Coding Agents.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-knowledge-builder/): Main project overview, features, and evidence.
- [Repository](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-knowledge-builder): GitHub repository, source code, and release tags.

## Core Features & Architecture

- **Primary Interface**: CLI and programmatic API.
- **Verification Gates**: Rigorous automated checks with reproducible evidence.
- **Deterministic Workflows**: Predictable outputs and contract enforcement.
